scope: Exact-frame semantic landmark measurements from existing LUNA, ERNA and NOIR candidate manifests; no source pixels or accepted artwork changed.

notes: Coordinate grids and all 27 source frames were visually inspected by root. Coordinates remain approximate candidate anchors, not fit approval.
One visible ankle is suitable only for a small trim detail; it is not a completed replacement for paired shoes. Do not center footwear between the feet.
Use bookPalm only for holding-hand details. The free hand moves independently and has separate coordinates.
Erna layered, Luna staff fallback and furniture-reading frames are outside this table.
Collar/amulet must stay below the chin and behind casting forearm/book; face ellipse alone is insufficient for all occlusion.
